# 猫猫本地实时字幕 0.1.32

## 下载

- [Windows 安装版](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download/releases/download/v0.1.32/OCCAT-Live-Caption-0.1.32-windows-x64-setup.exe) · [免安装版](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download/releases/download/v0.1.32/OCCAT-Live-Caption-0.1.32-windows-x64-portable.zip)
- [Mac · Apple 芯片](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download/releases/download/v0.1.32/OCCATLiveCaption-0.1.32-macOS-arm64.dmg) · [Mac · Intel](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download/releases/download/v0.1.32/OCCATLiveCaption-0.1.32-macOS-x86_64.dmg)
- [Windows SHA-256](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download/releases/download/v0.1.32/SHA256SUMS.txt) · [macOS SHA-256](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download/releases/download/v0.1.32/SHA256SUMS-macOS.txt)

## 更新

- 修复同一位置连续点击置顶后，取消置顶的按钮仍显示启用色的问题。现在只有实际置顶时持续显示主题色，未置顶时的悬停与按压使用中性反馈。
- 保持标题栏提示、键盘操作与真实窗口置顶状态同步；最小化和关闭按钮保留原有主题色交互。

此版本为公开测试版。适用环境与使用说明见[项目主页](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download)；识别和翻译结果请人工核对。[0.1.31 与其他旧版](https://github.com/occat666/occat-live-caption-download/releases)继续保留。
